decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan; 02; 03; Received 08/03/2018; Arboricultural Report; Tree details; Tree Constraints Plan; Received 24/05/2018; 05C; Received 06/06/2018; 04G; Received 12/06/2018.) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of works, tree protection measures as stated n the submitted Arboricultural Report and in line with Tree Constraints plan both received 24/05/2018 and hereby approved shall be installed, photographed and retained for the entire period of works at the site. The excavation and foundation works shall be overseen by a qualified Arboriculturist at all times and all the works shall be monitored in line with the Arboricultural Report and photographed and logged as evidence. At the end of the works and prior to occupation, all the evidence, Arboriculturist reports and final health inspection to the adjoining trees shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey side extension to existing retail unit.
